name: How do I choose the right contractor for my attached ADU project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my attached ADU project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience with ADU projects, reviewing their portfolio, checking references, and ensuring they are licensed and insured in California. Look for a contractor who understands local zoning laws in your specific area (e.g., Los Angeles, Studio City) and can provide transparent, detailed proposals. A good contractor will communicate clearly and offer solutions tailored to your property and budget. We invite you to review our credentials and past projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured contractor with ADU experience, a strong portfolio, good references, and a clear understanding of local regulations.
